claims.statement: The AC-16 run wrapper invokes the complete, unfiltered 20-gate local quality aggregate behind make verify and binds its external record to the source tree. Acceptance requires an independently observed full run and a matching complete successful record; wrapper tests or a report audit alone are not execution proof.

The bounded audit rejects missing, incomplete, failed or source-mismatched quality evidence. It checks a host-trusted tree-keyed record for consistency, not authenticated execution, and does not convert local quality results into AC-15 no-external-network proof or final clean-state acceptance.

A structural validator is reused only within one catalog compilation for the same resolved schema path and freshly read exact content. Every record is still structurally validated; existing model and semantic validation paths remain unchanged. Changed or invalid schemas are revalidated; no cross-compilation catalog cache, coverage reduction, test filter or deadline extension is introduced.

limitations: The full quality run is a separately observed execution of python -B -m scripts.ac_16_quality run. The short manifest gates exercise wrapper regressions and audit its actual external record; they do not rerun the full aggregate or replace direct observation with synthetic evidence.

The audit checks source and report consistency on a trusted local host. It does not authenticate execution or defend against an administrator fabricating a fully consistent report. Missing actual full-run evidence remains a verification failure.

The complete local aggregate contains 20 gates, the existing 17-module safety-coverage policy and all 16 registered browser runners. The policy's existing source-pinned coverage exclusion remains explicit; a coverage pass is not exhaustive semantic or interleaving proof.

The local quality aggregate does not select the additional clean-state and paired Compose backup acceptance gates or separately qualify native startup/restart acceptance. It is not DEL-01, EXEC-07 or final-source release acceptance.

Existing local network guards and canaries remain unchanged. AC-15's independent kernel-level no-external-network acceptance is neither completed nor waived; its separately approved correction and four-suite verification occur on a different source branch. No Docker or network policy change is authorized by AC-16.

History evidence gate deadlines remain unchanged. The separately observed aggregate retains its existing per-gate timeouts; the bounded audit is not a weakened or filtered substitute for that execution.

CI remains paused. No provider credentials, external delivery, optional PostgreSQL qualification, production identity, deployment or remote exactly-once result is established by this local quality requirement. Generated evidence remains sanitized and outside Git.
